title: TriDot Training Plan Sync Gap Watch
dataSources: TrainingPeaks workouts (`trainingpeaks:workout`), Garmin multisport activities (`garmin:multisport`), TriDot plans (`tridot:plan`), brick workouts (`brick:workout`), and transition logs (`transition:log`).
app: TrainingPeaks structured workouts, Garmin multisport FIT exports, TriDot training plans, brick workout logs, and transition timing notes ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=tridot:plan
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by phase
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>72
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects when TriDot training plan data has stopped arriving for a given training phase.
value: Personal telemetry is only useful when it is current; sync-gap alerts catch failed exports and broken credentials early.
implementation: Track the latest event time per training phase and alert when the feed is older than 72 hours.
visualization: Table of entities by hours since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It monitors when one part of your TriDot training plan feed has stopped checking in and probably needs fixing.
